summary.timing_boundary: Action-query timings are grouped by transform implementation and process-first versus subsequent queries; execution is decoded BF16 VQ/A4 with BF16 KV cache, so these values do not measure a native low-bit kernel. Fifteen-second GPU utilization/VRAM samples are collected separately in the PBS job log.

training.loss: first10 x6 motor MSE + rho * frozen normalization_c * clean future global NMSE excluding frame0
training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final update80 only; no held-out checkpoint selection or early stopping

clipping.scope: one FP32 ratio per target Linear, shared across tokens and denoising steps
clipping.rule: scale = absmax_per_token * ratio / 7; round and clamp [-7,7]; BF16 dequantized operand
clipping.backward: input STE inside clipping range; LSQ-style scale surrogate normalized by sqrt(numel * 7); absmax treated constant
clipping.fixed: Smooth0.5/H128 signs/scales, VQ indices, B32 uint8 exponents, bias, non-target model parameters, BF16 KV

scaling.position: after fixed Smooth0.5/H128, before dynamic per-token A4
scaling.forward: D=exp2(FP32 per-input-channel log2 scales); Q_A4(Z/D;ratio) @ BF16(original decoded Wq * D).T + bias
scaling.backward: same coupled stored-weight LSQ surrogate; retain each input channel instead of B32 aggregation; sqrt(rows*1*7) normalization and layer centering
scaling.storage: additional FP32 log2 scales; original integer B32 exponents unchanged; no rounded deployment substitution
scaling.training_evaluation: same compensated BF16 weight path; backward recomputes transient compensated matrix to avoid per-step dense copies; final eval caches same compensated weights
scaling.original_weight_content: codebooks, indices, row gains and original B32 exponents frozen; BF16 compensation rounding measured in original coordinates
scaling.initialization: original C8 rho1.5 baseline, log2D=0 ratio=1; no B32 warm start

softbin.statistics: all original C80 teacher, no heldout; action per axis, latent per channel; fixed population mean/std
softbin.aggregation: KL across value bins at each paired scalar position, then mean; no spatial or temporal histogram pooling

source_objectives.legacy_training_loss_field: inherited source metadata for hyperparameter parity; actual new objectives are specified here

startup_checks.reference_kind: saved exact final80 source action/future replay, uncached/cached full-query parity, actual infer action parity

protocol.claim_scope: two exact frozen final80 loss-trained checkpoints, each paired280 LIBERO-Plus episodes; decoded BF16 VQ/dynamic A4/BF16 KV; no retraining or heldout checkpoint selection; no native kernel performance claim
